title: Clause 9 - Performance evaluation
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 9: monitoring, measurement, internal audit, management review.

sections.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation (9.1)
prompts: Confirm AI performance and assurance metrics are defined and collected.
Verify metric thresholds trigger investigation or escalation.
Cross-check measurement frequency against documented policy.

sections.title: Internal audit (9.2)
prompts: Verify the AIMS internal audit programme exists and is risk-based.
Check NCs from internal audits are tracked to closure.

sections.title: Management review (9.3)
prompts: Confirm management review covers all required inputs (incidents, KPIs, risk changes).
Verify outputs are actionable with owners and dates.

checklists.text: Monitoring KPIs defined per AI system.
Internal audit programme covers all in-scope clauses/controls.
Management review minutes show AIMS topics discussed.
Action items from review have owners and target dates.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: How is the internal audit programme prioritized?
What KPIs surface AI risk to management?
Show us the most recent management review pack.
